dialogue.text: Toma: That duck comes here when the road gets noisy. We leave the shallow bank to it.

description: A working fisherman who jokes that the sea takes his hooks and the pond usually returns them. He is distinct from the coast-road thief with the same name.

links.description: After an optional battle, he explains that Psyduck comes down when the road grows noisy; the fishermen leave the shallow bank to it. This is ordinary accommodation, not treatment as a sacred guardian.
